title: What's new
items: Added explicit backup type selection during import (Google Drive Backup vs Manual Backup).
Manual .flex backup imports now read real folder paths from Documents/... and preserve document names correctly.
Improved handwriting cleanup to reduce hover/start trails and ghost connector strokes in problematic drawings.
Improved annotation thickness handling by deriving per-stroke width from Flexcil drawing metadata.
Refined predefined shape rendering with better arrow geometry and corrected fill behavior for box-like symbols.
Library view options now include Default, A4 Preview, and Original thumbnail mode, plus adjustable grid size.
